# Domain-purity baseline (ADR-0002) — grandfathered violations, BURN DOWN ONLY.
# Never add entries: a new framework import in the domain layer fails CI outright.
# Delete a line here in the same PR that fixes (or removes) the import.
#
# HISTORY — the eight openbank-libs-domain Jackson entries that used to sit here are GONE.
# #3670 added them when the gate's scope was widened from the `*/domain/*` PACKAGE PATH to the
# whole openbank-libs-domain MODULE: not new code, just code in a part of the module the gate
# had never opened (80 of its 107 main sources). Widening a gate's scope always uncovers
# pre-existing violations, and grandfathering them is what makes the widening shippable.
# The follow-up PR paid all eight off, each by the move ADR-0122 actually prescribes:
#   - ApiError / CursorPage: wire DTOs whose @JsonInclude shapes the HTTP envelope — they ARE
#     the serialization boundary, so they moved to openbank-libs-runtime, package unchanged.
#   - OpaSidecarPolicyDecisionPoint / FlagdProvider: HTTP+Jackson infrastructure adapters;
#     moved to libs-runtime beside the ports (PolicyDecisionPoint / FeatureClient) they
#     implement, which stay in the domain module. Package unchanged, so no consumer import moved.
#   - CompliancePackParser: split rather than moved. The decoder was already format-agnostic
#     (`fromMap` takes an already-parsed Map), so all of it stays in libs-domain and only the
#     three-line JSON front-end became `CompliancePackJson` in libs-runtime.
# What is left below is older debt from the pre-#3670 scope, tracked separately.
# Do not add further entries.
openbank-agent-service/src/main/kotlin/com/openbank/agent/domain/McpTypes.kt:import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonInclude
